predicate.label: known or named as
predicate.definition: Entity X is explicitly known, named, renamed, or referred to by alternative name Y for the same entity.
includes: a stated alias or alternative name
historical renaming of the same entity
excludes: a named subsidiary or distinct entity
comparison or resemblance rather than identity
ordinary description without an alternative designation
ambiguous: unclear referent of the alternative name
an explicitly proposed new name without established use
name versus separate institution when unresolved
predicate.notes: The predicate concerns two names or designations of one referent. Do not infer identity from an ownership relationship.
predicate.scope_notes: Includes: explicit known-as or also-called identity; a stated alias or alternative name; historical renaming of the same entity. Excludes: a named subsidiary or distinct entity; comparison or resemblance rather than identity; ordinary description without an alternative designation. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear referent of the alternative name; an explicitly proposed new name without established use; name versus separate institution when unresolved. The predicate concerns two names or designations of one referent. Do not infer identity from an ownership relationship.
